comment: Per-entry expectations for the gallery CI job (gallery/_ci_check.py). An entry not listed here defaults to {"run": "pass", "export": []}: it must exit 0 offline and is not export-checked. List an entry only to mark export targets or to declare a non-pass run outcome. Run values: "pass" (exit 0), "tool_error" (exit non-zero with a named tool-failure line). Export targets: "verifiers", "openenv".
